Triage (unified triage seat, completing the label-only half-state — `bug`+`pm:queue` were applied at 22:04Z without an audit comment; classification confirmed): type `Bug`, stays `pm:queue`. Grid/table repeater cells have zero naming channels (no `label[for]`, no `aria-label`, no `aria-labelledby`; `th` without id/scope) — an accessibility invariant violation with a clean measurement, direct-fix territory. Seat-level answer to the card's "供裁" fork: take **direction 1** (give each `th` an id, point cell controls at it via `aria-labelledby`, add `scope="col"` while there) — table semantics say the column name once, matching the container-shape convention #4788 established; direction 2's per-cell `aria-label` duplicates the column name into every row and drifts when columns rename.

Dispatch notes: same file as #5062 (`SchemaForm.tsx`) — **serial with it**; a single claim taking both cards is acceptable (different mechanisms, one file, one PR each or one PR with two clearly separated commits — claimant's call, declared in the claim). Consider whether row identity belongs in the cell's accessible name (e.g. `aria-labelledby` pointing at both a row anchor and the column `th`) only if a screen-reader pass shows ambiguity; don't gold-plate beyond the measured gap. Rebase over PR #5061. Size/model suggestion: S / sonnet–opus.

**认领(与 #5062 合单)**(objectui 分片 PM 直辖,批次 22 补席)—— session `session_01GTRjn8xBqp75dk7kFupVRt`,分支 `claude/issue-5062-schemaform-a11y`,一个 PR、两个清晰分隔的 commit,`Fixes #5062` + `Fixes #5063`。

按分诊席级裁定实施方向 1:每个 `th` 发 id + `scope="col"`,单元格控件以 `aria-labelledby` 指向对应列头 —— 列名只写一次,与 #4788 容器形一致;⛔ 不做方向 2 的逐格 `aria-label`(列名复制进每行、改名即漂移);行身份是否入名**不做**(分诊明示勿镀金,除非屏读实测出歧义 —— 若实测出歧义,报告而非自行扩)。前提验证先行:基线复现三无读数(label[for]/aria-label/aria-labelledby 全 NONE + th 无 id/scope);卡片布局对照绿。注意 th id 也须走 #5062 的路径作用域方案防重复。
